errors.claim: In several countries and territories, over 90% of people lack basic soap and water to wash their hands at home.
errors.reason: The statistic measures the percentage of people who DO have handwashing facilities with soap and water, not those who lack them (which would be well under 10% in the countries listed like Mexico, etc.).

claims.support: Indicator measures the percentage of people living in households that have a handwashing facility with soap and water available on the premises.
Global disparities in handwashing facility availability.

claims.text: In several countries and territories, over 90% of people lack basic soap and water to wash their hands at home.
claims.support: Contradicts evidence; rates are the percentage with access, not lacking access.

claims.text: Mexico has 98.8% of homes with soap and water. In Liberia, it is just 3.5%.
claims.support: Mexico value is 98.786...% (displayed as 98.8%), Liberia value is 3.487...% (displayed as 3.5%).

claims.text: Liberia is the world's lowest. Most families lack even a basin with soap on the premises.
claims.support: Liberia rank is 110 out of 110, making it the lowest in the universe. Value is 3.5%, meaning most families do lack it.

claims.text: India has 89.7%, which is 26 times what Liberia has.
claims.support: India value is 89.7% (89.69%), Liberia is 3.5% (3.49%). 89.69 / 3.49 is approximately 25.7 times (~26 times).
China value is 97.3% (97.266%), Pakistan value is 84.8% (84.767%).

claims.text: The bottom is a stark contrast. Sudan has 10.8%. Burundi, 6.4%, and Ethiopia, 5.9%.
claims.support: Sudan value is 10.8% (10.76%), Burundi is 6.4% (6.36%), Ethiopia is 5.9% (5.85%).

claims.text: Nigeria has 31.3%. For many, a bucket with a tap is a luxury.
claims.support: Nigeria value is 31.3% (31.31%). Definition includes buckets with taps as handwashing facilities.

claims.text: YOUR HOME? Access to soap and water

title.reason: Accurately reflects the World Bank indicator for handwashing facilities with soap and water.

description.reason: Inverts the statistic, stating over 90% lack access when the data shows over 90% have access in several countries.

beat_0.reason: Mexicos value is 98.8% and Liberias value is 3.5% in the dataset.

beat_1.reason: Liberia is ranked 110 (lowest) and has 3.5%, meaning most lack the facility.

beat_2.reason: India is 89.7% and Liberia is 3.5%, with India being roughly 26 times higher.

beat_3.reason: China is 97.3% and Pakistan is 84.8% in the dataset.

beat_4.reason: Sudan is 10.8%, Burundi is 6.4%, and Ethiopia is 5.9%.

beat_5.reason: Nigeria is 31.3%, and buckets with taps are part of the facility definition.
